name: pi-code
description: Manage Pi Agent inside Visual Studio Code

virtualWorkspaces.description: Pi Code runs shell commands and reads project files from disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Project-local agent resources and command execution stay disabled until the workspace is trusted.

pi-code.enableTodoTool.markdownDescription: Expose the `update_todo` tool and inject the reminder checklist into environment details.

pi-code.enableAskQuestionTool.markdownDescription: Expose the `ask_question` tool so the agent can request clarification mid-task.

pi-code.enableAgentRules.markdownDescription: Load project context files (`AGENTS.md` and friends) into the system prompt.

pi-code.enableSkillDiscovery.description: Allow the model to invoke discovered skills on its own.

pi-code.autoApproveSkillReads.description: Approve reads inside skill directories without prompting. Requires Auto Approve Read.

pi-code.autoApproveWrite.description: Approve file writes and edits without prompting.

pi-code.autoApproveExecute.description: Approve shell command execution without prompting.

pi-code.allowedReadPaths.description: Glob patterns that are always readable when auto approval is on.

pi-code.deniedReadPaths.description: Glob patterns that can never be read.

pi-code.allowedWritePaths.description: Glob patterns that are always writable when auto approval is on.

pi-code.deniedWritePaths.description: Glob patterns that can never be written.

pi-code.allowedDeletePaths.description: Glob patterns that are always deletable when auto approval is on.

pi-code.deniedDeletePaths.description: Glob patterns that can never be deleted.

pi-code.allowedExecuteCommands.description: Command prefixes or globs that are always executable when auto approval is on.

pi-code.deniedExecuteCommands.description: Command prefixes or globs that can never be executed.

pi-code.autoCompactContext.description: Summarize the conversation automatically as it approaches the context limit.

pi-code.autoCompactContextPercent.description: Percentage of the context window to fill before auto compaction runs.

pi-code.maxOpenTabsContext.description: Maximum number of open editor tabs listed in environment details.

pi-code.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of workspace files listed in environment details.

pi-code.excludeIgnoredFiles.description: Hide files and folders matched by .gitignore when listing workspace files in environment details.

pi-code.maxGitStatusFiles.description: Maximum number of changed files listed in environment details.

pi-code.maxConcurrentFileReads.description: Maximum number of files the read tool loads in parallel.

pi-code.maxToolOutputLines.description: Maximum number of lines kept from a single tool result.

pi-code.maxToolOutputSizeKb.description: Maximum size in kilobytes kept from a single tool result.
